description: This header file declares functions and bindings related to image processing in a Lua/C++ project. It includes functions for loading images, drawing images, cropping images, and setting up Lua bindings for image objects.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads a PNG or JPEG image from the specified path and returns an Image instance.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Draws an Image instance to the screen at specified coordinates, with optional width and height.

methods.name: lu5_image_get
methods.description: Gets a cropped Image from an existing Image.

methods.name: lu5_image_index
methods.description: Handles indexing for image objects in Lua.

methods.name: lu5_image_bind
methods.description: Binds image functions and methods to the Lua environment.
